BiblicalUsage: Sethar is an Aramaic word for hiding — or for tearing down. Daniel praises the God who reveals deep and secret things, and Ezra records the other side of it — how God gave the house into Nebuchadnezzar's hand to be destroyed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that nothing stays hidden from God, and nothing He hides stays hidden from us for ever.
